Priya: Customer asked for CAIQ-safe single-line responses mapping keys/backups/logs to owners. Need final wording.
Ethan: Short answers only. Which deployment are they testing?
Priya: POC uses Hosted for dev, moving to Dedicated for prod. Private only if requested.
Noah: Quick baseline: Hosted = Redwood-managed by default; Dedicated = configurable (Redwood or BYOK); Private = customer-managed.
Ethan: Draft one-liners for CAIQ: 
- Keys: Hosted - Redwood-managed by default; Dedicated - supports BYOK (customer-managed keys) per contract; Private - customer-managed.
- Backups: Hosted/Dedicated - Redwood-managed encrypted snapshots with configurable retention; when BYOK is enabled snapshots are encrypted with customer's KMS; Private - customer-managed unless we provide managed-services.
- Logs: Platform operational logs retained by Redwood (default 30 days; enterprise optional 90/365); application logs in Private are customer-controlled.
Priya: Add explicit statement that Redwood does not retain plaintext customer keys and that BYOK encryption is applied to backups when enabled.
Noah: Added: "We do not store plaintext customer keys; snapshots encrypted with customer KMS when BYOK enabled."
Ethan: Customer also wants a single shared-responsibility row for the CAIQ spreadsheet. Suggest CSV style line they can paste: 
"Component,Hosted,Dedicated,Private
KeyMgmt,Redwood-managed (BYOK opt-in),Redwood-managed or Customer BYOK,Customer-managed
Backups,Redwood-managed snapshots,Redwood-managed or Customer option,Customer-managed
Logs,Platform:Redwood (30d); App:Customer,Platform:Redwood (30d); App:Customer,Customer-controlled"
Priya: Perfect. Legal wants a parenthetical: "BYOK subject to contractual terms" after Dedicated BYOK.
Ethan: Inserted. Final lines are ready to paste.
OpsBot: CAIQ draft saved: https://redwood.internal/caiq/1782304512-draft (editable) :white_check_mark:
Priya: Thanks. I'll send to the customer with the note about contractual BYOK language and offer an ops call if they want retention SLAs.
Noah: Ping me if they request encryption proofs or architecture diagram.
Priya: Will do. :thumbsup:
